The TD.95 features a robust PC/ABS enclosure, ideal for indoor/outdoor applications. This antenna performs excellent without a ground plane – 3dBi Gain with an Omni-directional pattern for constant reception/transmission. Recommended for high powered 1w LoRa radios: Excellent low-gain antenna for 1w radios for uniform omnidirectional coverage. When you have a high-powered radio, you don’t need to sacrifice your upper and lower viewshed by focusing your transmit power with a high-gain antenna. Instead, use a low gain antenna like the TD.95 to have superior transmit and receive from all directions. The ultimate omnidirectional antenna!
